name: TRIBE Bali Legian
short_description: A 113-room design-led lifestyle hotel in Legian, rebranded from ibis Styles Bali Legian after a full renovation that closed the property from April to August 2026.
ai_summary: TRIBE Bali Legian sits on Jalan Padma Utara, just north of Kuta and within walking distance of Legian Beach. The property closed on April 1, 2026 for a complete renovation and reopened in August 2026 as TRIBE's second Indonesian hotel, with the same 113 rooms now reworked with locally-inspired interiors and flexible layouts for short or extended stays. Amenities include swimming pools with a kids' corner, a gym, a spa and salon offering Balinese treatments, a private meeting room, and dining at Folk and Fare alongside Huddles Sports Bar and a lobby/pool bar. As a newly reopened property, it does not yet have an established run of guest reviews under the new branding.

pros: Walking distance to Legian Beach, within easy reach of Kuta and Seminyak
113 rooms fully renovated in 2026 with locally-inspired interiors and flexible layouts
Swimming pools with a dedicated kids' corner, plus a gym and private meeting room
Spa and salon offering Balinese treatments
Three dining/drinking venues: Folk and Fare, Huddles Sports Bar, and a lobby/pool bar
cons: Reopened in August 2026 after a five-month closure, so it doesn't yet have an established run of guest reviews under the TRIBE brand
As a design-led midscale property, it sits a tier above budget but still below Bali's full-service resorts nearby
research_highlights: The Legian Beach walking-distance location and easy reach of Kuta/Seminyak carry over from the property's prior branding
The 2026 renovation added a broader dining lineup (Folk and Fare, Huddles Sports Bar) and a private meeting room not present under the old ibis Styles branding
Family-friendly touches, including a dedicated kids' pool corner, are retained post-renovation
research_watchouts: The property only reopened in August 2026 as TRIBE Bali Legian -- no meaningful volume of guest reviews exists yet under the new brand, so early sentiment here is provisional

faqs.question: Is TRIBE Bali Legian the same hotel as ibis Styles Bali Legian?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's the same 113-room property on Jalan Padma Utara in Legian, rebranded after Accor closed it on April 1, 2026 for a full renovation and reopened it in August 2026 as TRIBE Bali Legian, the brand's second hotel in Indonesia.

faqs.question: Is TRIBE Bali Legian close to the beach?
faqs.answer: Yes -- it's within walking distance of Legian Beach, just north of Kuta, putting it in easy reach of both Kuta and Seminyak for beach days and nightlife.
